title: Unit 2: The Ways We Learn
objective: Mampu menggunakan present perfect dengan 'for' dan 'since' untuk menyatakan periode waktu, meminta dan memberi izin, serta membicarakan mata pelajaran sekolah dan cara belajar.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas present perfect tense dengan fokus pada penggunaan 'for' dan 'since' untuk menyatakan durasi waktu. Present perfect digunakan untuk menghubungkan masa lalu dengan masa sekarang, terutama ketika membicarakan pengalaman atau situasi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut hingga sekarang.
rules: Present Perfect dengan 'for': Subject + have/has + past participle + for + periode waktu. Contoh: I have studied English for three years.
Present Perfect dengan 'since': Subject + have/has + past participle + since + titik waktu tertentu. Contoh: Children have made fantastic things since the school started.
Penggunaan 'for': Digunakan untuk menyatakan durasi/periode waktu (a month, three years, a long time). Contoh: Tinkering School has been around for many years now.
Penggunaan 'since': Digunakan untuk menyatakan titik waktu kapan suatu kegiatan dimulai (last summer, 2014, Friday). Contoh: I have been at my new school since last December.

Article usage: Gunakan 'a/an' untuk benda tunggal yang tidak spesifik, 'the' untuk benda spesifik yang sudah diketahui, atau tanpa artikel untuk benda jamak/umum. Contoh: You can have an apple or a banana. / The apples in this pie are from our garden.

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula bingung kapan menggunakan 'for' dan 'since'. 'For' digunakan untuk durasi (berapa lama), sedangkan 'since' untuk titik waktu (sejak kapan).
commonTrap.wrong: I have lived here since five years.
commonTrap.correct: I have lived here for five years. / I have lived here since 2021.

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara anak dan orang tua tentang meminta izin untuk meminjam barang

lines.speaker: Nick
lines.text: Will you let me use your laptop?

lines.speaker: Dad
lines.text: I'm afraid I need it myself right now.
lines.translation: Maaf, Ayah sendiri sedang membutuhkannya sekarang.

lines.speaker: Annie
lines.text: Can I watch the football match tonight?
lines.translation: Bolehkah aku menonton pertandingan sepak bola malam ini?

lines.speaker: Annie
lines.text: Can I ask you something, Mum?

speakingLab.context: Simulasi percakapan tentang kegiatan belajar dan pengalaman sekolah dengan tutor Mr. Khoirul

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! I'd like to know about your school life. Which are your favourite subjects? Which ones don't you like? Why?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I really like English and Drama. I don't like Maths very much because I find it difficult.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's interesting! How long have you studied English? And have you ever performed in a school play?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I have studied English for five years now. Yes, I performed in a school play last year.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Can you tell me about your daily school routine? What time do you usually arrive at school and what activities do you do?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I arrive at school at 7:30. I have classes until 2:00, and sometimes I have extra activities after school.

quiz.question: Children have made fantastic things ______ the school started.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'since' karena 'the school started' adalah titik waktu tertentu di masa lalu, bukan durasi waktu.

quiz.question: Tinkering School has been around ______ many years now.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'for' karena 'many years' adalah periode/durasi waktu.

quiz.question: I ______ (be) at my new school since last December.
quiz.explanation: Present perfect 'have been' digunakan dengan 'since' untuk menyatakan situasi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut.

quiz.question: Can I borrow your bike? - No, sorry. I ______ it.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan present simple 'need' untuk menyatakan kebutuhan saat ini ketika menolak permintaan izin.

quiz.question: Which sentence uses articles correctly?
options: You can have apple or banana.
You can have an apple or a banana.
You can have the apple or the banana.
quiz.answer: You can have an apple or a banana.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'a/an' untuk benda tunggal yang tidak spesifik. 'An' sebelum vokal (apple), 'a' sebelum konsonan (banana).

quiz.question: I have to ______ very carefully about what I'm doing when solving maths problems.
quiz.explanation: 'Concentrate' berarti memusatkan perhatian dengan seksama, yang tepat untuk konteks memecahkan soal matematika.
